data.body:
Pushed for review: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1483

Commit a32fcbde7c on branch pr125-zizmor, worktree /Users/joeoakhart/rebar-pr125,
branched from origin/main c89a2ddcc4. Trailer verified with
'rebar verify-commit-ticket' -> OK, resolved 7466-fe00-bfb3-4a71.
Signed-off-by RebarBotNava <joeoakhart+bot@navapbc.com>.

Local gate results in the worktree (venv provisioned at Python 3.12.13 to match CI,
via 'uv venv --python 3.12 .venv' + 'uv sync --locked --extra dev --extra agents'):
  * make lint      -> PASS. ruff check, ruff format --check (1778 files), complexity
                      baseline (new=0 increased=0), DCO identity, criteria vocabulary,
                      zizmor v1.29.0 on release.yml ('No findings to report', 1
                      suppressed), actionlint all workflows.
  * make typecheck -> PASS. mypy: no issues in 436 source files.
  * uv lock --check -> exit 0.
  * make test      -> still running locally (large suite); CI's Verified gate is the
                      authoritative run and this change touches no source file.

Worth recording: the ~47k 'deprecated vocabulary' violations that make lint reports in
the main checkout did NOT reproduce here. This worktree is fresh from origin/main and
has no .claude/worktrees/ or bridge_state/ directories, which corroborates that the
violations come from those gitignored paths being scanned rather than from repo content
(bug a5f5's sibling). Also note 'make worktree' would have provisioned with ambient
python3 (3.14.6 on this host) rather than CI's 3.12 - provisioned manually here.
